---
mode: agent
description: Generate, review or improve professional UI/UX using the governed UI/UX Pro Max workflow.
---

Apply the repository skill `.codex/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md`.

For the requested interface:

1. identify the product, audience, user journey, surface, target stack and business outcome;
2. read `design-system/MASTER.md` and any relevant page override when present;
3. run the local UI/UX Pro Max design-system search when its generated scripts are available;
4. select one coherent visual direction;
5. implement or review the interface;
6. validate responsiveness, WCAG AA accessibility, focus behavior, reduced motion, empty/loading/error/success states and performance;
7. remove generic AI-interface patterns and decorative elements that do not serve the user journey;
8. finish with changed files, test evidence, remaining risks and rollback instructions.

Do not publish, merge or deploy without the applicable repository approval gate.
